mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.5% indicates a weak labor market that typically triggers monetary policy easing, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE >= 6.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS rising) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, strong industrial production growth signals sustained economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, INDPRO signal fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 1.0% signals a tightening monetary policy stance that increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 1.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in nonfarm payrolls and decline in unemployment rate indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), the economy is contracting, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
